title.native: ノブナガ先生の幼な妻

media.description:
"One day, there'll be a girl who'll fall head over heels for me."

Nobunaga was a teacher who was waiting for that kind of dating sim event to happen in real life. One day, a 14 year old girl named Kicho appears in front of him, saying that she's his wife?! Apparently she came from the Warring States era and seems to have mistaken Nobunaga for the Oda Nobunaga and tells him that she wants to have his children. An age-gap love comedy featuring a teacher with a dating sims brain and a princess with a warring states era brain!!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.romaji: HELLO WORLD if: Kadenokouji Misuzu wa Sekai de Saisho no Shitsuren wo Suru

media.description: In Kyoto in the year 2027, Naomi Katagaki, a male high school student encounters a person who is claiming to be Naomi from 10 years in the future. Together, they must change the future and save a classmate, Ruri, whom the younger Naomi starts to date in three months.

title.native: ベイビーアイラブユーだぜ

media.description:
Japan-based confectionery company Lotte opened a special site to celebrate the 70th anniversary since its founding in 1948. The centerpiece of the commemorative website is a new animated musical short featuring the song "Shinsekai" (New World) by the band Bump of Chicken.

The video centers on a middle school boy-meets-high school girl scenario. They are surrounded by a wide range of characters who are all "spirits" of various Lotte snacks, such as a men's singing group representing Ghana chocolate bars and, well, Koalas representing Koala March.

(Source: Anime News Network)

synonyms: Weathering With You - Das Mädchen, das die Sonne berührte
media.description:
High school student Hodaka leaves his home on an isolated island and moves to Tokyo, but he immediately becomes broke. He lives his days in isolation, but finally finds a job as a writer for a shady occult magazine. After he starts his job, the weather has been rainy day after day. In a corner of the crowded and busy city, Hodaka meets a young woman named Hina. Due to certain circumstances, Hina and her younger brother live together, but have a cheerful and sturdy life. Hina also has a certain power: the power to stop the rain and clear the sky.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Hachi-nan tte, Sore wa Nai deshou!

media.description:
Ichinomiya Shingo, a 25-year-old man working at a firm company, while thinking of tomorrow's busy working day, goes to sleep. However, when he woke up, he found himself in a room unknown to him and realized that he is inside a 6-years-old body, taking over his body and mind.

He soon learns from the memories of the boy that the boy was born as the youngest child of a poor noble family living in a back country. Having no administrative skill, he can't do anything to manage the vast land his family has.

Fortunately, he is blessed with a very rare talent, the talent of magic. Unfortunately, while his talent could bring prosperity to his family, in his situation it only brought disaster. This is the story of the boy, Wendelin Von Benno Baumeister, opening his own path in a harsh world.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: バーチャルさんはみている

media.description:
An anime featuring various VTubers, virtual characters featured in vlogs, game streams, and other content on video sites and livestreaming services. The central Vtubers in the series are Mirai Akari, Denno Shojo Siro, Tsukino Mito, Tanaka Hime, Suzuki Hina, and Nekomiya, who also form a special idol unit called "Virtual Real".

The anime features an omnibus sketch comedy format, with each segment highlighting different Vtubers in absurd situations. Another segment features fan-submitted characters made with the custom Vtuber mobile app, Custom Cast.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.english: Aggretsuko: We Wish You A Metal Christmas
title.native: アグレッシブ烈子：We Wish You a Metal Christmas

synonyms: Aggretsuko: Feliz Navidad y Próspero Heavy Metal

media.description: Red panda Retsuko, worked to the bone, unleashes her frustration in the form of death metal. Lately, though, she's found another joy—getting the most likes possible on her Instagram posts. In fact, it is said that social media attention can release endorphins. As Christmas falls upon the city, Retsuko's hunger for validation only grows, pushing her to find new ways to embellish and sugarcoat her otherwise drab life for the internet to see.

The chronometer is a legendary treasure that has the power to manipulate time.

The Susanoo Incident unfolded in the capital of Kyoto and ended with the death of the masked shogun, Mugensai. Having finished visiting the grave of his former master, Yoshida Shouin, Takasugi Shinsaku and his partner, Katsura Kogorou, return to Kyoto once again.

Suddenly, the earth trembles and the sky splits open, and the chronometer, which was supposed to have been destroyed, appears from a rift in space-time. Now with a will of its own, the chronometer starts going on an uncontrollable rampage!!

(Source: crunchyroll)

media.description:
Daia, a virtual PriChan idol, announces the Jewel Auditions, where only ten PriChan idols will become Jewel Idols, and among them one will be selected as the Diamond Idol. Mirai finds a new dream of becoming the Diamond Idol. Meanwhile, a new PriChan shop called Dear Crown has opened, and two new idols from that shop start to participate in the Jewel Auditions.

(Source: Anime News Network)

The horse girls are back to charm you in this special, bite-size anime. Umayon comes alive as a cute and eye-catching anime! At a school-turned-training facility, the girls will race, perform, and train... but that's not all! Saddle up for a short-form anime that displays the laidback school days of the horse girls! Aaaaand, they're off!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

media.description: An anime adaptation of Sega's Phantasy Star Online 2 game's official web manga Puso Ni Comi: Phantasy Star Online 2 Comic. The story follows the lax, less than weighty daily life of the ARKS force members.

media.description: A mysterious creature named UMA (Unidentified Mysterious Animal) appears in Lala's gummy case and then uses a power to whisk the Pretty Cures to a faraway place. Though they can't communicate with words, song seems to work just fine. UMA is so precious to the universe, but alien hunters are after UMA! The whole universe is in danger if they catch UMA. UMA must be protected and the hunters defeated!

title.native: 白猫プロジェクトZERO CHRONICLE

media.description:
The war between the Kingdoms of Light and Dark has raged on since time began. But the new Prince of Darkness is destined to change that.

In the wake of a monster attack, an elderly noble confronts the lone surviving boy. Impressed, he chooses the boy to become his heir to the Throne of Darkness. Meanwhile, in the iridescent clouds above, the Queen of Light and her army are at war with the monsters. But the new Prince of Darkness realizes that Light and Dark must unite and destroy the evil if the world is to survive.

(Source: Funimation)

An experiment concerning the attempts at creating a ‘moving image’ long before the invention of cinema. A re-experiencing of the history of ‘magic with light’ unfolds through the use of various devices and techniques, including flip-book animation and Muybridge’s photographs in motion zoopraxiscope.

(Source: IFFR)

Asami Ike released a Christmas Advent animation each day counting down to Christmas. She posted it on her official Twitter page. In total pieces 17 were made including day 12-15 which are live-action. A compilation of the whole advent was posted to her official YouTube channel.

The film is about a family, [that] runs a chicken farm. The boy hankers after birds and his little sister keeps an eye on him. The father loves eggs. The mother loves somebody else. In the family fixture, each member stays there with bias or secrets.

Graduate Work 2012, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation

media.description:
Discover the adventures of the cat painter, Vincent van Meowogh who lives in a mansion in Paris surrounded by his quirky friends. Let's give him a spark of inspiration for his painting by completing puzzle stages, buy back the furniture and restore his home to its former glory!

(Source: Anime News Network)

A man walks in a crowd. He cannot stand the crowd but to cover his ears. Then it disappears and he gets lost in a white void space. In that space there is no other man but himself. He had nothing to identify himself and his existence was to come to naught. He starts to struggle to get away from there.

1st Year Work 2010, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation

'There is a fusuma (paper sliding door) work based on the Hannya Shingyo (Prajna-paramita Hrdaya Sutram) by woodblock print artist Shikou Munakata. He wrote the sutra in one go without any rough drafts or scketches and the result is a very powerful and compelling work. Ever since I first saw this fusuma I have had a special interest in the Hannya Shingyo... ' (extract of the commentary by Keiichi Tanaami)
